additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398840-Si-D/FR-[MP / P5 170000504] Chademo connector error CRM:01410001374
additional_info.body:
Hello Florent,
Hope you are doing great.
We would like to inform you that the regional team has replaced the transducer. Please ensure to perform some tests beforehand. According to the report, the Chademo is now working.
Additionally, we have checked the SCB, charger, and connectors, and they are in healthy condition. We request you to check the charging on the Chademo connector and provide us with your feedback.
Once the charger is confirmed to be in healthy condition, we recommend updating to the latest firmware version 6.0.3.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
